title: Structural and mechanical properties of refractory Nb30X25Ti25Al15V5 (X = Zr, Mo) high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by arc melting in a highly pure and inert argon atmosphere with 40 homogenization cycles (flipping and remelting) to incorporate all elements, then cast into a water-cooled copper die
